# Pratyansh Singh

> Pratyansh Singh is a Software Developer and QA engineer at AAROHII AI SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED, based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India. He builds and tests SaaS products and works mainly with Python and Django.

## Key facts
- Name: Pratyansh Singh
- Role: Software Developer (development & QA)
- Company: AAROHII AI SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED (since February 2026)
- Location: Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Education: GLA University
- Skills: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, React Native (Expo), software testing, visual regression testing, CI/CD
- Goal: build technology products and, eventually, a business

## Products he works on (AAROHII AI SOLUTION)
- [ViraQueue](https://viraqueue.com): live AI-powered social media management platform. His work: scheduling and workflow logic, testing, UI/UX improvements, automation features, bug identification.
- [Captverse](https://captverse.com): live AI operating system for businesses (CRM, sales, inventory, payments, AI agents). His work: CRM, inventory and real-time chat modules.
- [PixellPeep](https://pixellpeep.com): live visual regression testing platform. His work: CI-ready APIs, CLI support and multi-algorithm diffing.
- Auvora: a VMS platform, currently in development (not launched).
